gloss: last place; lowest rank; bottom position

definitions.gloss: last place; lowest rank; bottom position
definitions.explanation: The lowest position in a ranking, competition, or hierarchy. The very bottom of a list or standings.

examples.japanese: {最下位|さいかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{最下位|さいかい}だ。
examples.english: This team has been in last place for three years in a row.

examples.japanese: {最下位|さいかい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{這|は}い{上|あ}がって→這い上がる：06269_haiagaru⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}する→優勝する：25496_yuushousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧なこと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Climbing up from last place to win the championship is no easy feat.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{最|さい}→最〜：03954_sai⟧ (most) + ⟦{下位|かい}→下位：11710_kai⟧ (lower rank). The superlative form of ⟦{下位|かい}→下位：11710_kai⟧, meaning the very lowest position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最下位|さいかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沈|しず}む→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧: to sink to last place
- {最下位|さいかい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{脱出|だっしゅつ}する→脱出する：26829_dasshutsusuru⟧: to escape last place
- {最下位|さいかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to finish in last place
- {最下位|さいかい}⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧: a battle to avoid last place
- ダントツ{最下位|さいかい}: dead last by a wide margin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{下位|かい}→下位：11710_kai⟧: lower rank — a relative position, not necessarily the very bottom
- ⟦ビリ→ビリ：23005_biri⟧: last place — a more casual, colloquial word
- ⟦{最上位|さいじょうい}→最上位：24315_saijoui⟧: top rank — the opposite, the highest position
- ⟦{首位|しゅい}→首位：14677_shui⟧: first place, the lead — the top of the standings

USAGE:
Commonly used in sports standings, exam rankings, and corporate performance comparisons. The casual synonym ⟦ビリ→ビリ：23005_biri⟧ is more common in everyday conversation, while {最下位|さいかい} is used in formal or written contexts.
